## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run open-source:check`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/smoke_test.py ./backend`
- [ ] Manual app test, if UI or packaging changed

## Safety and Distribution

- [ ] No model binaries, generated outputs, user media, or secrets are committed.
- [ ] The change is compatible with `docs/RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior, packaging, or model handling changed.
